description: What a reporter hears of a describe-level retry under Jest 30.5.2 (T5.10, B23d): a custom reporter appends one line per `onTestCaseStart` and `onTestCaseResult` call to `calls.txt`, over a block (`jest.retryTimes(1, { entireDescribe: true })`) whose first attempt fails and whose second passes, each attempt making a different number of passing assertions. The results file holds the final attempt's `numPassingAsserts`. One Jest worker. A black-box run.
